resolution: (1) Seorak Cable Car: the official site's live feed, read 12:15 KST Wed Oct 7 2026, shows hours of 08:30-17:30 today and tomorrow and 08:00-17:30 on Fri Oct 9 (Hangeul Day). Hours are set day by day, so expect about 08:00/08:30-17:30 for Oct 19-23. 17:30 is the close (ticket sales and last boarding). Adult round trip is 16,000 KRW and confirmed on the official 2026 fare table. Round trip only; there is no hiking trail down from the top. Tickets are sold only on the day at the 1st-floor counter or kiosk, with no advance booking. Each ticket is printed with a boarding time. The site shows no per-person limit (the only '1 ticket per person' rule is for the Sokcho-resident discount). A full refund is possible up to 10 min before boarding; after that, a time change or refund costs 20%. There is no official data on weekday sell-out times. On Oct 7 midday (a weekday, before peak) the wait was only 19 minutes. At peak, waits of 1-3 h are common, and on weekends the day's slots can be fully allocated by around midday. Plan to be at the counter by 08:00-08:30 on a weekday. Confidence: high for fare and sales rules, medium-high for hours, low for sell-out timing. (2) Heullimgol: it is OPEN for autumn 2026 and a reservation IS required, Oct 1-Nov 30 2026. The 5,000/day cap is correct (gangwon.json was right) and applies to the 3.1 km one-way section from the Heullimgol Visitor Center to Yongso junction. It is split into hourly slots of about 1,000 each: 08:00-15:00 in October, 09:00-14:00 in November. One booking covers up to 10 people. Online booking (reservation.knps.or.kr, Korean site) closes at 14:00 the day before. Leftover places can be registered on site at the Heullimgol Visitor Center. Hiking without a booking can draw a fine (200,000 KRW for a first offence, up to 500,000), and no-shows get booking bans. The reopening date was Sep 8 2022 (planned for Sep 6 but delayed by Typhoon Hinnamnor), after a closure from Aug 2015 that followed a fatal rockfall. foliage.json's '2024' is wrong; gangwon.json's 'Sep 6 2022' is the planned date. I found no 2026 rockfall closure, though the trail is closed on the day in rain or strong wind. Foreigners: KNPS's English/foreigner portal lists only shelters and campsites, not trail reservations. The Korean site normally requires Korean mobile or i-PIN identity verification, so online booking with a foreign phone is unlikely to work (unverified). The realistic routes are on-site leftover registration at the Heullimgol Visitor Center, which is very likely available on a weekday given the 5,000 cap, or a booking made by a Korean contact or the hotel. The booking-open date is not published; it closes at 14:00 the day before. Juongol from Osaek out and back (to Yongso Falls) needs NO booking, and two-way walking is allowed there. The reservation and the one-way rule apply only to the Heullimgol section, and walking up it in reverse is forbidden. Confidence: high (KNPS service guide + Oct 5 2026 Maeil Shinmun + Sep 2026 Travel News). (3) Buses after the 9% cap rise on Oct 1 2026, adult weekday fares. Seoul Express Bus Terminal (Gangnam) to Sokcho: standard 18,700 / deluxe (udeung) 24,300 / premium 31,500 / late-night about 29,100, about 2h35-3h, 45 departures a day 06:00-23:30. Dong Seoul to Sokcho: deluxe 22,800 / premium 29,600, about 2h16-2h26, 15 a day. Gangneung to Sokcho intercity: mostly 8,400 (direct, about 1 h), with 10,800 on slower 1h40-1h46 runs. The 7,800 fares on 2 runs look like pre-rise data that has not been updated. These figures come from asamaru timetable mirrors dated Oct 2-7 2026, because kobus.co.kr refused connections and was not checked directly. Foreign cards: Kobus has accepted foreign-issued Visa/Mastercard since Aug 2024 (the year comes from the Korea JoongAng Daily article on KTO plans; not seen directly). The T-money intercity site has an English version (intercitybuse.tmoney.co.kr) with a foreign-card option reported. Klook sells express-bus tickets as a fallback. Terminal kiosks and counters take foreign cards and cash. Confidence: medium-high for fares, medium for card acceptance.

places.name: Seorak Cable Car (Sogongwon to Gwongeumseong)
places.summary: 5-min ride (10 min round trip) to about 700 m near Gwongeumseong fortress. Two 50-passenger cabins run every 5 min when busy and every 10-15 min otherwise.
places.why: The core view of the Seorak day; Biseondae can be walked while waiting for the printed boarding time.
places.autumn_note: No senior discount Sep 19-Nov 15 2026 (peak season). Waits of 1-3 h at foliage peak.
places.time_needed: 1.5-2 h including time at the top (the last car leaves only about 10-20 min at the top)
places.hours: Set daily. Oct 7-8 2026: 08:30-17:30; Oct 9 (holiday): 08:00-17:30. Expect about 08:00/08:30-17:30 on Oct 19-23; check the homepage the day before.
places.closed: Open every day; suspended in high wind or for safety checks (unused tickets refunded)
places.cost_note: Adult (middle school and older) round trip 16,000; child 12,000; under 36 months free. No one-way tickets, no group discount. Full refund until 10 min before boarding; 20% fee after.
places.booking: Same-day on-site sale only (1st-floor counter or kiosk); no advance reservation. Each ticket carries a boarding time. No per-person limit is published.
places.tips: Take Sokcho city bus 7 or 7-1 to Seorak-dong; be at the counter by 08:00-08:30 on a weekday. Buy tickets, then walk Biseondae (about 1 h each way) and come back for the slot. The Sinheungsa lot (033-636-4050) is full before 08:00 on peak days.

places.name: Heullimgol trail (reservation section, Nam-Seorak)
places.summary: A 3.1 km one-way reservation section from the Heullimgol Visitor Center past Yeosim Falls, Deungseondae and Sibi Falls to Yongso junction. It continues untimed down Juongol to Osaek, about 6.2 km and 3.5-4 h in total.
places.why: South Seorak's best foliage gorge walk.
places.autumn_note: Reservations Oct 1-Nov 30 2026. October entry is 08:00-15:00 in hourly slots; November entry is 09:00-14:00.
places.closed: Closed on the day in rain or strong wind; there are 22 rockfall-risk points with warning lights. No 2026 rockfall closure found.
places.booking: reservation.knps.or.kr (Korean site): 5,000/day with about 1,000 per hour; up to 10 people per booking; online booking closes at 14:00 the day before; leftovers registered on site at the Heullimgol Visitor Center. Fine for entering without a booking: 200,000 KRW for a first offence, up to 500,000. The foreigner portal does not offer trail bookings.
places.tips: Foreigners without a Korean phone should plan on on-site leftover registration on a weekday (high chance given the cap) or have the hotel or a Korean contact book. One-way only: no walking up from Osaek past Yongso junction. The trailhead has no parking.

places.name: Juongol valley out-and-back from Osaek
places.summary: Flat gorge path from Osaek village to Yongso Falls and back, about 3 km each way.
places.why: The no-booking fallback with the same autumn colours.
places.autumn_note: Peak usually in the last third of October.
places.booking: None required; two-way walking allowed (only the Heullimgol section is reservation-only and one-way).
places.tips: Do not continue past Yongso junction up toward Heullimgol (forbidden direction).

transport.booking: kobus.co.kr / Express Bus Mobile app (foreign Visa/MC accepted since Aug 2024), Klook, or terminal kiosk
transport.notes: Fares after Oct 1 2026: standard 18,700 / deluxe (udeung) 24,300 / premium 31,500 / late-night about 29,100. Pre-rise: 17,200 / 22,300 / 28,900.

transport.booking: txbus.t-money.co.kr / intercitybuse.tmoney.co.kr (English), terminal kiosk, or just turn up (rarely sells out midweek)
transport.notes: Most fares are 8,400 on direct runs and 10,800 on slower runs; 7,800 on two runs is probably stale pre-rise data.

tips: Seorak weekday plan: buy cable car tickets about 08:00-08:30, walk Biseondae during the wait, ride, then go to Osaek in the afternoon for Juongol (no booking), or do Heullimgol on a different morning.

Heullimgol for foreigners: arrive at the Heullimgol Visitor Center for an 08:00-10:00 slot on a weekday and ask for on-site leftover registration (잔여분 현장접수). Or have the hotel book the Korean KNPS site before 14:00 the previous day.
Use the Express Bus Mobile app or Klook with a foreign card for Seoul-Sokcho; seats sell out on Friday evenings and on Sunday returns in October.
Cable car live status (hours, wait, current boarding time) can be checked from the official homepage or the JSON feed /api/public/field-data.
warnings: Heullimgol needs a reservation from Oct 1 to Nov 30 2026; entering without one risks a 200,000 KRW fine. Booking online with a foreign phone is probably impossible because the Korean site needs identity verification.
foliage.json's '2024 reopening' is wrong. Heullimgol reopened Sep 8 2022 (gangwon.json's Sep 6 was the planned date, delayed by a typhoon).
Cable car hours are posted daily and can be cut by wind; the last car leaves only 10-20 min at the top.
Bus fares were checked on an asamaru mirror of kobus/T-money data (Oct 2-7 2026), not on kobus.co.kr directly, because that site refused connections from here.
